name: Air Jordan CP3.IX
story: Chris Paul’s signature CP3.IX debuted this Clippers-friendly colorway in 2015. Based in vibrant Soar blue, the mid-top’s Flight Web Fit System constructed upper is highlighted by navy and teal. Other signature details include Infrared branding, a teal outsole, and teal speckling throughout.

name: Reebok Club C 85 Prince White
story: Developed in partnership with the iconic tennis brand, the Prince x Reebok Club C Revenge ‘White Bright Cobalt’ gives a nod to the retro silhouette’s hardcourt roots. The white leather upper features tonal mesh paneling throughout the vamp and a suede forefoot overlay in a light grey finish. A logo window on the lateral side displays Prince and Reebok Vector logos, while mismatched heel tabs display a Prince wordmark on the right shoe and Reebok branding on the left. Vibrant pops of yellow land atop the nylon tongue and on the sneaker’s translucent rubber outsole, which reveals an oversized Prince logo underfoot.

name: Undefeated x Zoom Kobe 4 Protro
story: The Undefeated x Zoom Kobe 4 Protro 'Sail' is part of the premium pack from Nike's collaboration with Los Angeles retailer Undefeated. Released on Mamba Day—April 13th, 2019—this version of the Kobe 4 originally designed by Eric Avar and Tom Luedecke delivers an eye-popping new look while conserving its innovative performance features: lightweight Flywire lockdown, soft Lunarlon foam cushioning and Nike Zoom Air units for low-profile responsiveness.

name: Authentic 'Leopard'
story: Defining the brand's heritage in 1966, the Vans Authentic has outpaced its origins as a modern style staple. This 'Leopard' rendition—arrived in August 2012—enlivens the custom canvas upper and tongue with a daring allover pattern and metallic rivets. A signature flag label and a rear license plate hallmark the look. High foxing, a vulcanized midsole and Waffle outsole nod to the style's predecessor.

name: Nike KD 4 Scoring Title
story: This limited edition Nike Zoom KD 4 'Scoring Title’ dropped in July 2012 to celebrate Kevin Durant’s third straight NBA scoring title. It boasts a Tour Yellow and Photo Blue Hyperfuse upper with special branding on the tongue that features the numbers 30.1, 27.7, 28—Durant’s point-per-game averages during those three seasons. The low-top also comes with a Lemon Twist Swoosh on the midfoot strap, Zoom Air cushioning in the sole and laser-etched detailing on the toe box, heel and translucent outsole.

name: Nike Air Force 1 Low LV8 Smoke Grey Red Reflective Swoosh
Jordan 1 Retro High OG Hand Crafted
story: The Air Jordan 1 High OG ‘Hand Crafted’ treats the iconic silhouette to an eclectic color palette. The upper features a white leather base with brown nubuck forefoot overlays, green nubuck eyestays, a magenta leather heel overlay, and reflective silver trim along the quarter panel and heel. Additional details include a stitched leather Wings logo on the lateral collar flap, two-tone dyed laces, and a standard Nike-branded woven tag atop the nylon tongue. A rubber cupsole with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning anchors the high-top.

name: Nike Kobe 1 Prelude (81 Points)
story: The first ever retro of a signature Kobe sneaker, the ‘Prelude’ colorway of the Kobe 1 dropped in 2013 as a tribute to one of Bryant’s finest performances: scoring 81 points against the Toronto Raptors in 2006. The sneaker, in shades of black and grey, honors the achievement with a graphic print on the collar and Swoosh, while a snakeskin pattern emerges on the rest of the upper. A white patch, marked with ‘81pts’ in gold lettering, appears on the insole.

name: Jordan 36 Psychic Energy
story: The Air Jordan 36 ‘Psychic Energy’ showcases a classic color palette that honors the heritage of the Jordan franchise, while recognizing the vision of the athletes who further its legacy. The lightweight silhouette carries a white jacquard leno-weave upper with contrasting hits of black on the synthetic nubuck collar and tongue. The latter is accented with a glossy Jumpman in University Red. Responsive cushioning is provided by a full-length Zoom Air Strobel stitched directly to the upper, along with an additional Zoom Air unit stacked below the forefoot. The sneaker rides on a Phylon midsole with a hollowed-out section underneath the Eclipse Plate. A translucent herringbone-traction rubber outsole delivers superior grip underfoot.

name: Copa Sense.3 Laceless TF 'White Solar Red'
D.O.N. Issue #3 Little Kid 'Cadet Sonic Ink'
Nike Retro GTS 97 Black White
story: The Nike GTS 97 ‘Black’ brings back a ‘90s stalwart in a simplistic two-tone color scheme. The low-top carries a black recycled canvas upper with embroidered Swoosh branding on the quarter panel and tonal leather heel tab. A padded tongue combines with a low-cut, mesh-lined collar for a comfortable fit. The sneaker is mounted on a white vulcanized rubber midsole with a contrasting black pinstripe and reinforced bumpers at the toe and heel. Underfoot, a herringbone-traction rubber outsole provides reliable grip.

name: Jordan 3 Retro Black Flip
story: The Air Jordan 3 became a sneaker classic in 1988 with its iconic elephant print detailing. To continue the model’s legacy, Nike released the Air Jordan Retro 3 'Flip' that flips the elephant print and leather positions on the upper. The sneaker sports an all-black leather upper with tonal elephant print on the sidewall, leather details on the inner lining and Metallic Silver accents on the tongue and heel branding. The mid-top also boasts a visible Air Sole unit in the midsole.

name: Force Zoom Trout 5 'White Metallic Red Bronze'
Off-White x Dunk Low 'Lot 30 of 50'
story: This Off-White x Nike Dunk Low is taken from the ‘Dear Summer’ collection, a sprawling follow-up to Virgil Abloh’s first Nike Dunk collaboration from 2019. The low-top makes use of a white leather upper with soft grey canvas overlays, along with Virgil Abloh’s calling-card flourishes, which include a plastic zip tie and printed Helvetica text.   Contrasting pops of color arrive via the sneaker’s secondary lacing system, zip-tie, an exposed-foam tongue and a rectangular tab affixed to the Swoosh. Limited to fifty pairs, a ’30 of 50’ badge is affixed on the lateral midsole.

name: New Balance 990v4 Kith United Arrows ＆ Sons (TD)
Solebox x EQT Support 'Poppy'
story: Berlin's Solebox store collaborated with adidas for a limited release of the Solebox x EQT Support 'Poppy' sneaker. The shoe was one of two performance runners remixed in the 'Then and Now' pack, alongside an adidas adiZero Aegis 2. This 'Poppy' shoe mixes shades of grey with black and a brilliant red hue for a dimensional look. Three-Stripes branding and a coordinating lace lock complete the look.

name: UBIQ x N9000 'Whiz Wit'
story: Issued in January 2017, the UBIQ x Diadora N9000 'Whiz Wit' sneaker pays homage to the clothing's store hometown of Philadelphia. The upper is a contrast of leather and suede with a striking lateral logo to represent the signature blend of ingredients used in the famed Philly cheesesteak. A ring of stars and 'Wit' and 'Witout' branding are debossed on the heel. The speckled EVA midsole and rubber outsole continue the narrative.

name: National Geographic x Wmns Nano X1 Vegan 'Arctic Tundra'
story: Launching as part of a footwear collaboration with the iconic travel magazine, the National Geographic x Reebok women’s Nano X1 Vegan ‘Arctic Tundra’ features a synthetic and plant-based build highlighted by a breathable Flexweave upper in an icy blue finish. A subtle crackle pattern is applied to the woven tongue tag and heel overlay, the latter contrasted by a yellow heel strip marked with Nano X1 branding. A translucent heel clip extends to a Floatride Energy Foam midsole made with castor bean.

name: Pharrell x Human Race Sichona 'Burgundy'
story: Designed in collaboration with the multifaceted creative, the Pharrell x adidas Human Race Sichona ‘Burgundy’ introduces a silhouette whose name translates to the Indigenous phrase for ‘connecting to the earth,' or the Dakota tribe’s way of saying ‘barefoot.’ The sneaker’s seamless construction is built with adidas’ Futurnatural technology, highlighted by a maroon Primeknit upper that’s merged with a magenta-colored, anatomically molded TPU midsole. ‘Humanrace’ is printed in yellow lettering across the lateral quarter panel, while adidas branding decorates a pink webbing pull tab atop the tongue. Underfoot, the rubber outsole features a digitally printed Humanrace typographic pattern.

name: Flex Plus SE GS 'Pink Crimson Tint'
Peppa Pig x Club C Slip-On 4 Toddler 'Play Dreamy'
Jordan Max Aura 4 TD 'White Hyper Royal'
Nike LeBron 6 Athlete
story: Limited to just 150 pairs, the 2008 Nike Zoom LeBron 6 'Athlete' was inspired by a series of Nike commercials from 2006 that depicted the four sides of LeBron’s personality: the Athlete LeBron, the Business LeBron, the Kid LeBron and the Wise LeBron. It boasts a t-shirt-like Neutral Grey melange upper with white leather overlays and black and Baltic Blue accents. A photo of the commercial’s ‘Athlete LeBron’ character is also featured on the inside of the tongue, with a silhouette of the character accenting the footbed.

name: OTTO 958 x Protoblast 'Dark Brown Pure Gold'
Wmns Air Zoom Pegasus 38 FlyEase Wide 'Black Metallic Gold Coin'
Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme White
story: Debuting as part of the New York brand’s Spring/Summer 2020 collection, the Supreme x Air Force 1 Low ‘Box Logo’ delivers a minimalist take on Nike’s iconic silhouette. The low-top features an upper crafted from full-grain leather in a monochromatic white finish, accented with Supreme’s signature red box logo on the lateral heel. Additional Supreme branding hits appear on the custom sockliner and a secondary set of red laces.

name: adidas Forum Snipes Detroit Bad Boys
story: Limited to just 1,200 pairs worldwide, the Snipes x adidas Forum 84 High ‘Detroit Bad Boys’ pays tribute to the Pistons teams from ’89 and ’90, whose bruising style of play earned the Isiah Thomas-led squads to back-to-back championships. The retail sneaker chain dresses the vintage hoops shoe in a black patent leather upper with white three-stripes and contrasting orange accents. They include an adidas Trefoil atop the signature X-shaped overlay and ‘89’ and ‘90’ embroidered on the toe of each shoe. Atop the tongue, a metallic gold adidas tag is joined by the sneaker’s numbered edition.

name: Futura Laboratories x Echo Boot 'Army Green'
story: The Futura Laboratories x Crocs Echo Boot 'Army Green' makes use of a green Croslite foam upper with a zippered ripstop shroud, secured with a cinch pull around the cuff and covered in Futura's handwritten script. Two engraved dog tags complement a webbing heel loop marked with Futura Laboratories branding. Underfoot, the outsole features an exaggerated rubber tread for durable traction.

name: Nike Air Trainer SC High Escape
LEGO x Sport Pro J 'White Red'
Scuderia Ferrari x Drift Cat Delta Little Kid 'Black White'
Milk Makeup x Club C 85 Vegan 'Equipment Room'
Nike Air Max Courtballistec 4.3 Agassi Pack
Air Jordan 32 Low GS 'Camo'
story: Jordan Brand debuted the Air Jordan 32 Low ‘Camo’ as a kids exclusive in January 2018. The low-top iteration features a black upper with camouflage accents over the quarter panel and collar along with metallic gold Air Jordan and Jumpman branding. A black midsole and gum rubber outsole complete the look underfoot.

name: Nike Jordan Air Ship PE SP Nigel Sylvester Bike Air (Friends and Family)
silhouette: Nike Jordan Air Ship Pe Sp

name: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 MX Oat
story: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘MX Oat’ delivers a vibrant departure from the brand’s typically muted color palette. The upper is composed of re-engineered Primeknit and features a tan base with swirling hits of yellow, royal blue and fiery orange. The minimalist build is equipped with traditional lace closure, a pull tab at the heel and a post-dyed monofilament side stripe woven into the side panel. Responsive cushioning is provided by a full-length Boost midsole wrapped in semi-translucent rubber.

name: Wmns Dunk High 'Washed Denim'
story: The Nike women’s Dunk High ‘Washed Denim’ updates the retro hoops shoe with a refreshed build that calls to mind a vintage pair of blue jeans. The upper combines a white leather base with washed denim overlays and a signature Swoosh in Habanero Red. Additional crimson accents make their way to Nike branding hits on the woven tongue tag and sockliner. An off-white finish on the rubber cupsole accentuates the shoe’s aged aesthetic.

name: Jordan 4 Retro Where the Wild Things Are (PS)
story: Made for little kids, the Air Jordan 4 PS ‘Wild Things’ adds warm fleece construction to the padded collar and tongue, the latter accented with an embroidered Jumpman icon. The rest of the upper is built with tan leather and a quartet of color-popped eyelets in neon green, pink, blue and red. A second Jumpman logo embellishes a molded heel panel in dark beige. The sneaker sits on a two-tone foam midsole, supported by an outsole built with gum rubber under the forefoot and heel.

name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High NYC '23NY' Sample
Nike Kobe 6 Protro EYBL
story: Paying tribute to Nike's Elite Youth Basketball League, the Nike Kobe 6 Protro 'EYBL' features a gradient purple finish on the snakeskin-like upper, highlighted by a series of polyurethane 'islands' throughout a breathable micro-mesh base. Kobe Bryant's personal logo appears on the tongue, while the EYBL insignia adorns the speckled black heel counter. The low-top rests on a lightweight Cushlon midsole with a large and flexible Zoom unit in the forefoot.

name: Jordan 11 Retro Low Cement Grey (TD)
story: Built for little feet, the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low TD ‘Cement Grey’ offers a fresh take on a classic silhouette. The low-top features a white ballistic mesh upper with tonal webbing eyelets and a grey patent leather mudguard. Contrasting pops of University Blue land on the Jumpman branding hits that adorn the tongue and back heel. Lightweight cushioning comes courtesy of a crisp white foam midsole, reinforced underfoot by a translucent rubber outsole.
